disclosures.storage: LlamaIndex VectorMemory over SimpleVectorStore; a fresh VectorMemory per benchmark question inside one long-lived process
disclosures.writePolicy: Store each haystack session's whole transcript under its session id; no LLM runs at ingest
disclosures.retrievalPolicy: VectorMemory.get with the question as input and similarity_top_k set to the request's topK; returned chat messages are deduplicated back to session ids in score order
disclosures.providerCostBoundary: Local CPU embeddings only; no LLM, no API key, no remote inference provider
notes: Retrieval lane only: a pure retriever returns unsupported for the memories lane rather than a proxy.
First execution downloads the pinned 67 MB embedding model; that download is outside the reported wallMs.
